verdict.rationale: Flagright documents two REST APIs, FRAML and Management, with OpenAPI specs and official Python and Node clients. Together they cover the core UI objects: users, transactions, rule templates, rule instances, cases and case statuses, and alerts. However, there is no parity claim, several UI-marketed features have no evidenced API surface, and webhook secret rolling is described as a Console action. Missing for 10: an explicit API/UI parity statement, and API coverage of Rule Simulation, Workflow Builder, watchlist-screening configuration, SAR/regulatory filing and webhook secret management.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can do everything through the API that I can do in the UI
